import sys

MOD = 998244353

def power_mod(b, e, m):
    return pow(b, e, m)

def process():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])

    inv2 = power_mod(2, MOD - 2, MOD)
    diff = R - L + 1
    p1 = diff // 2
    p2 = diff - p1
    nm = n * m

    if nm & 1:
        ans = power_mod(diff, nm, MOD)
    else:
        pp1 = diff
        pp2 = abs(p1 - p2)
        opt1 = power_mod(pp1, nm, MOD)
        opt2 = power_mod(pp2, nm, MOD)
        opt = (opt1 + opt2) % MOD
        opt = (opt * inv2) % MOD
        ans = opt

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    process()
